summary: 50 mm drivers and a self-adjusting headband.
headline: 50 mm drivers. A fit that adjusts to you.
description: A self-adjusting suspension headband and soft over-ear cushions keep the fit simple. Choose digital USB-A or 3.5 mm analog audio.

features.title: Self-adjusting fit
features.text: The suspension headband settles into place as you put the headset on.

features.title: Game-tuned 50 mm drivers
features.text: Full-size drivers deliver game audio, dialogue and music through an over-ear design.

features.title: Dual-mic ENC over USB
features.text: One microphone captures speech and a second picks up ambient sound for noise reduction.

variants.name: USB-A wired
variants.description: Digital audio with dual-mic ENC and RGB lighting.

specs.label: Audio control software
specs.value: Windows only. Four presets, custom EQ and adjustable sidetone.

variants.name: 3.5 mm wired
variants.description: Analog audio for devices with a compatible headset jack. Plug into BL10 for desktop Game/Chat control on Windows.
